objects.name: Analytic 2206
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows host querying device operating state or process values via vendor Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) at a frequency or scope exceeding documented Human-Machine Interface (HMI) refresh behavior, from a process not in the recognized HMI/Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) application list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
